blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A 41-year-old parking attendant was killed in a shooting outside the Tabunok Public Market along N. Bacalso Avenue in Barangay Tabunok, Talisay City, shortly after 6 p.m. on Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026. Authorities identified the victim solely by his alias, “Dondel,” who lived in Molave Extension, Barangay Tabunok. The Talisay City Police Station responded to the scene after receiving an alert. Investigators discovered the victim lying in front of the market with multiple gunshot wounds; he was pronounced dead upon the arrival of emergency medical responders.
